_note: Phase B: a self-contained OPTIONAL side mission on the already-imported academy grounds (area 0, the front courtyard), to exercise the objective -> reward loop. ALL text is our own wording (not from any script). A nervous younger student has dropped three of his things on the lawn; find all three and bring them back for a cash reward. Pickups are interact triggers (no item mesh yet -> the HUD prompt stands in; a placeholder for a future small prop). Coordinates are UE cm within the walkable courtyard corridor used by 1_01 (x ~22000-28000, y ~6000-8500, z ~700). Start with Mission.Start side_errand, -BRMission=side_errand, or the headless smoke harness -BRMissionSmoke=side_errand. The on_complete reward pays UBullyProgressSubsystem (the HUD wallet, top right).
title: Campus Courier

stages.objective: A younger student in the courtyard looks like he needs a hand.

on_start.sub: There's a few coins in it for you

on_start.text: Someone dropped their things all over the lawn. Hear him out.

on_complete.text: Three things, scattered across the grounds. Round them up.

stages.objective: Find the first of his things (1 of 3).

on_complete.text: That's everything. Take it back to him.

stages.objective: Bring his things back to the courtyard.
